title: GC–EI Annotation Reliability Tool
description: Version 2.0.1 of the GC–EI–MS spectral annotation software. Provides a streamlined Streamlit interface with two separate, source-locked configurations: frozen research v2 (8,455 first14 connectivity reference identities, m/z-weighted cosine and an HGB confidence model trained on 1,410 development records) and retained legacy v1 (8,543 identities, optional RI-based search and source-dependent nominal conformal sets). Reports tentative database-connectivity candidates, original historical decision rules and complete version/provenance exports. The 609-case v2 within-MS-DIAL closed-library test observed 394/609 top-one publisher-label matches. No independent experimental authentication, prospective 5%/10% selected-error guarantee or cross-laboratory 90% set-coverage guarantee is claimed. Original publisher EI source spectra are not redistributed.
